                                      ORDINANCE                               , _ ^



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:



SECTION I . Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single Unit

(Detached House) District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 15-1 in an

area bound by




A line 186.6 feet south of and parallel to West Hollywood Avenue; the public alley next

east of and parallel to North Artesian Avenue; a line 216.6 feet south of and parallel to

West Hollywood Avenue; North Artesian Avenue




to those of a RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.




Common Address of Property: 5639 North Artesian Avenue
